page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the lower 25th percentile, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10th percentile. However, the 24 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance in the middle 50th percentile across stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached small-block reads reaching 982.55 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 90.83 GB/sec.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is structured for parallelizable compute-bound workloads rather than memory-heavy or single-threaded tasks. It is well-suited for multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and moderate database operations, all of which score in the average tier. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores for parallel processing without the added cost of bundled local storage or GPU hardware.
